create_document_text: create a Document dataclass instance with text content and metadata for RAG retrieval
create_document_multimodal: create a Document with multimodal ChunkList content and source URL for retrieval
create_document_chunked: create a chunked Document with chunk_number, total_number_of_chunks, and original_doc_id metadata
use_metadata_constants: use METADATA_FIELD_CHUNK_NUMBER, METADATA_FIELD_TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_CHUNKS, and METADATA_FIELD_ORIGINAL_DOC_ID constants for document tracking
access_document_text: access the Document.text property to get plain text representation with multimodal placeholders
